## element14 Community launches Rise of the Robots robotics design challenge


November 24, 2026


*Global engineering community invited to design and build innovative robotics projects*


[element14](https://community.element14.com/) , an Avnet Community, has launched the Rise of the Robots design challenge, inviting engineers, makers and technology enthusiasts to design and build innovative robotics projects using a kit of development hardware, motors and sensors.


Ten selected challengers will receive a free kit of components to support the design and build of their projects. Participants can explore a wide range of robotics applications, including hospitality, delivery, disaster response, industrial and companion robots.


Participants will document their build process through forum updates and a project blog, with entries evaluated based on innovation, technical merit and creative use of the provided components.


“Robotics brings together so many areas of engineering, from sensing and motion control to programming and intelligent systems,” **said Andreea Teodorescu, Global Director of Product Marketing and element14 Community** . “The Rise of the Robots challenge gives our community an opportunity to experiment with these technologies, develop creative solutions and share what they learn with engineers around the world.”


The first-place winner will receive a Makeblock Ultimate Robot Kit 2.0 and a Multicomp Pro 100 MHz tablet oscilloscope. Additional prizes will be awarded to second- and third-place winners, while participants who successfully complete the challenge will also receive a finisher prize.


Applications for the Rise of the Robots design challenge are open now through 13 December 2026. Winners will be announced in March 2027.


For more information and to apply, visit[the Rise of the Robots Robotics Design Challenge](https://community.element14.com/challenges-projects/design-challenges/rise-of-the-robots/dc/dc/92/rise-of-the-robots-robotics-design-challenge) page on element14 Community.
